verdict.rationale: Bitwarden hosts its own Swagger UI over a compliant OpenAPI 3.0.4 document for the Public API at bitwarden.com/help/api/, with a parallel Swagger UI for the Vault Management API. That gives users an interactive, explorable API reference with an in-browser console. However, the runnable console mounts client-side and was not observed working hands-on, and no curated runnable code examples are documented. missing for 10: hands-on confirmation that the try-it console executes requests, documented runnable example snippets beyond the raw Swagger UI, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples

citations.quote: Explore the OpenAPI Specification using the Swagger UI:
